cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Outfeel the Room
cards.instruction: Answer every fear, sacrifice, or disappointment with one of your own that deserves more attention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Empty seats at your opening aren't the worst result. Mine had two people and both left. Let's assess the damage accurately.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry. Have my complimentary drink.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. No ice, please; I'd like to taste the consolation. My theatre didn't provide any.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you listen now? My dad left before my scene.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mine asked for a refund. Please don't call both of those leaving early. Sit down; I need to tell someone what he said at the box office.

reason: Use A's corrective ranking of emotional harm to redirect B's attempt to be heard, rather than attaching professional filler to a comparison ladder.
